subject.title: fix(update): dev channel update builds from an unverified checkout at the git install path

question: Should package-to-dev conversion permanently refuse every pre-existing OPENCLAW_GIT_DIR, reclaiming only paths with matching updater-owned shared-state and checkout markers?
rationale: This is an intentional upgrade and operator-action contract that trades compatibility with existing checkout locations for a stronger code-execution trust boundary; source review cannot choose that product/security policy on behalf of the project.

options.title: Approve fail-closed conversion
options.body: Keep the fresh-path-only policy and document the one-time move-or-reconfigure action because remote URL validation cannot make an adopted checkout trustworthy.

options.title: Design a compatibility migration
options.body: Preserve a narrowly defined existing-checkout path only if maintainers can specify a security-equivalent migration and ownership proof.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed conversion
recommendation.body: Keep the fresh-path-only policy and document the one-time move-or-reconfigure action because remote URL validation cannot make an adopted checkout trustworthy.
